title: Linux Kernel ksmbd Share Configuration Race Condition Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Linux Kernel. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. Furthermore, only systems with ksmbd enabled are vulnerable.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of share_conf objects. The issue results from the lack of proper locking when performing operations on an object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the kernel.
addtionnal_details:
Linux has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/5258572aa5fd5a7ed01b123b28241e0281b6fb9b
